usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank, euro reference exchange rate (USD)
usdRate.note: USD 1.1172 per EUR, so EUR 0.8951 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.887. Andorra uses the euro under a monetary agreement with the EU.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook (DataMapper), Andorra inflation, average consumer prices
inflation_cpi.note: 2025 average 2.4% (end-2025 2.7%); the IMF projects 4.0% for 2026. Secondary source because the Andorra statistics portal (estadistica.ad) is a script-only map application that could not be read; the World Bank has no CPI series for Andorra.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% euro area target; IMF WEO Andorra CPI 2.4% (2025), 4.0% (2026 proj.), 2.0% from 2029
inflation_projection.note: Andorra uses the euro, so the ECB 2% target anchors inflation, but Andorran prices have run above the euro area, so 2.5% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Andorra uses the euro under a monetary agreement with the EU and has no own policy rate; ECB deposit facility 2.50%, main refinancing 2.65% from 16 September 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: No published savings account rates for Andorran banks were found; the AFA site lists no deposit rate statistics.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rates for Andorran banks were found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rates for Andorran banks were found.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No average deposit rate is published for Andorra (no World Bank FR.INR.DPST series, no AFA statistics found).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found in Andorra.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No Andorran treasury bill yield was found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published Andorran 5-year government bond yield was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No published Andorran 10-year government bond yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Wikipedia, Taxation in Andorra (personal income tax on savings income)
tax_bank_interest.note: The first EUR 3,000 of savings/investment income a year is exempt and the rest is taxed at 10%; secondary source because the Government tax pages could not be read.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: There is no government savings certificate in Andorra; any bond interest would fall under the 10% savings income tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Andorran Financial Authority (AFA), Fons andorrà de garantia de dipòsits (FAGADI)

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate for Andorra was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity in euro terms; ECB deposit rate 2.50%
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund in euros if world shares are weak; Andorra has no stock market.

equity_return_base.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50% less 10% savings tax = 2.25%; global equity in euro terms
equity_return_base.note: Andorra has no stock market, so the base case is a global index in euros, kept within 4 points of the after-tax euro safe rate of about 2.25%.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run record in euro terms
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run global equity returns in euros.

gold_return_low.sourceName: ECB euro reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold and a stronger euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: ECB euro reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no expected euro trend against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: ECB euro reference rate USD 1.1172 per EUR (30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker euro.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50%; Andorran bank deposit rates not published
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits paying well below the ECB rate, after 10% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50% less 10% savings tax = 2.25%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: euro term deposits a little below the ECB rate, after tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: ECB main refinancing rate 2.65%; euro government bonds
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer euro government bonds held to maturity after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found from the AFA.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates by age were found for Andorra.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay was found; CASS reimburses most of hospital costs.

health_premium_table.note: No published private (complementary) health insurance premiums by age band were found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: IMF WEO Andorra CPI; 2.5% planning inflation
goal_inflation_health.note: No Andorran medical price index could be read, so we plan with the 2.5% projection plus one point for medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: IMF WEO Andorra CPI; 2.5% planning inflation
goal_inflation_education.note: No Andorran education price index could be read, so we plan with the 2.5% projection plus one point for fees.

life_table_remaining.note: populationpyramid.net (UN WPP) has no Andorra page and the Andorra statistics portal could not be read; no life table at ages 60-80 was found.

support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio of 23.1 (2025). UN WPP projections for 2040 and 2065 could not be read for Andorra.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CASS (Caixa Andorrana de Seguretat Social), retirement pension
retirement_age_default.note: Ordinary retirement age 65 for men and women; early retirement from 61 with more than 480 months of contributions (7% reduction per year early); 180 months minimum.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age for Andorran public servants under the civil service law could not be confirmed; they draw the CASS pension from 65.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50%; Andorran deposit rates not published
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50% less 10% savings tax = 2.25%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax euro safe rate because Andorran 1-year deposit rates are not published.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: ECB main refinancing 2.65%; euro government bonds
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of euro government bonds after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50%; global equity in euros
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: ECB deposit facility 2.50%; global equity base 6% in euros
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: about half global equity at 6% and half euro fixed income at about 2.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Global equity high case 8% in euros
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Andorra has a means-tested solidarity pension for the elderly (Decree of 7-10-2020) and a non-contributory old-age pension law of 1988, but the amount could not be read on the Government or BOPA pages.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The eligibility age and means test of the solidarity pension for the elderly could not be read (BOPA decree page did not render).

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees was found in Andorra; severance applies only to dismissal.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CASS (Caixa Andorrana de Seguretat Social), retirement pension
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory points-based CASS pension from 65 (early from 61), at least 180 months of contributions; 5-15 years gives a lump-sum capital updated by CPI. No automatic yearly indexation of pensions was stated, so it is treated as not inflation-linked.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bill market for individuals was found.

tbond_5y.note: Government debt is placed with banks and institutional investors; no retail market or published yield was found.

tbond_10y.note: No retail market or published yield was found.

equity_fund.note: Funds supervised by the AFA; no local stock exchange, so equity funds invest abroad.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold was found.

centralBank.name: Andorran Financial Authority (Autoritat Financera Andorrana)
centralBank.note: Andorra has no central bank; it uses the euro (ECB policy) and the AFA supervises banks.

pensionScheme.name: Caixa Andorrana de Seguretat Social (CASS) – retirement pension

oldAgeAllowance.name: Solidarity pension for the elderly (Govern d'Andorra)

publicHealthCover.name: Caixa Andorrana de Seguretat Social (CASS) – health cover

depositInsurance.name: Fons andorrà de garantia de dipòsits (FAGADI)
